description: SvButton in production shapes for Svelte 5: a toolbar with primary, secondary, outline, ghost and danger variants, sm, md and lg sizes, a leading icon snippet, a loading state that shows a spinner and disables the button, and a full-width call to action through block. Variant, loading, icon, block and href are props, so a link that looks like a button needs no extra markup.

faq.question: How do I show a loading state?
faq.answer: Set loading while the async work runs. The button shows a spinner, keeps its width so the layout does not shift and ignores clicks until loading is false.

faq.question: How do I add an icon?
faq.answer: Pass an icon snippet with an SVG or an icon component; it renders before the label and the button spaces and sizes it for the chosen size.

faq.question: Can a button be a link?
faq.answer: Yes. Pass href and it renders an anchor with the same styling and variants, so navigation buttons stay accessible as links.
